articles.headline: Ben Rice hits 40th and 41st homers as Yankees beat Rays 9-2 a day after Tampa Bay clinches AL East
articles.description: — Ben Rice hit his 40th and 41st home runs, Ryan McMahon added a grand slam while matching his career high with five RBI and the New York Yankees beat the Tampa Bay Rays 9-2 on Wednesday night.

articles.headline: Gray earns 18th victory, Monasterio drives in run, and Red Sox edge Guardians 1-0
articles.description: — Sonny Gray pitched six innings to tie Philadelphia’s Cristopher Sánchez for the major league lead with his 18th victory, Andruw Monasterio drove in the only run with a sixth-inning single, and the Boston Red Sox edged Cleveland 1-0 on Wednesday...

articles.headline: Matthew Liberatore pitches Cardinals to 5-1 victory that halts Pirates' 5-game winning streak
articles.description: — Matthew Liberatore ended an 11-start winless stretch and Alec Burleson got his major league-best 112th RBI as the St. Louis Cardinals defeated the Pittsburgh Pirates 5-1 on Wednesday night.

articles.headline: Red Sox's Ceddanne Rafaela injures hamstring in IL return
articles.description: Ceddanne Rafaela, who returned Wednesday after being sidelined since Sept. 3 because of a right quad strain, left in the third inning because of tightness in his right hamstring.

articles.description: Blue Jays first baseman Vladimir Guerrero Jr. is standing by comments he made during a recent interview regarding his performance this season after signing a 14-year, $500 million contract last year.

articles.headline: Counsell says Cubs at disadvantage after schedule change
articles.description: Cubs manager Craig Counsell was quick to point out the disadvantages his team faces this weekend after the league moved Sunday's contest against the Boston Red Sox to Friday due to a poor weather forecast.

articles.headline: Walker Jenkins' pinch-hit RBI single in the 7th keys Twins' 4-2 victory over Giants
articles.description: — Pinch-hitter Walker Jenkins hit an RBI single in the seventh inning that put Minnesota ahead and the Twins won their second straight over the San Francisco Giants with a 4-2 victory on Wednesday.
